reports.summary: This Glitch rebuild captures the whimsical spirit of Ur right from the first second: you drop straight into Beau's Home Street with floaty low-gravity platforming, synthesized WebAudio music/SFX, thought-bubble tool animations, and plenty of interactive trees, rocks, shrines, critters, and toys (like racing wind-up Chick Cubimals, bestowing Random Kindness rainbows, and triggering Thriller dances with Pumpkin Ale). However, a few bugs and faithfulness gaps hold it back: the simulation loop only runs inside `requestAnimationFrame` (which freezes backgrounded player tabs in multiplayer), `#people-list` wipes `innerHTML` on every network state tick (swallowing clicks on other players), player and NPC speech bubbles cap their box width at 220-240px while drawing 350px+ text that spills out both sides, the Home Street left signpost fails the `< 300` boundary exit check, and the Andra Bureaucratic Hall skips the signature 10-second waiting-room timer gag from Footage B.
best: Cohesive multi-street world (Beau's Home Street, Chego Chase, Andra Bureaucratic Hall, Bongul Beat, Goli Grabs) with distinct palettes, synthesized WebAudio SFX/music themes, and immediate into-play onboarding.
Thought-bubble tool animations (pickaxe, watering can, shovel, daily Hi-sign) and whimsical Glitch toys (Chick Cubimal plank racing, Random Kindness rainbow arcs, Pumpkin Ale Thriller dance).
Rich verb-menu interactions across Beryl Rocks, Paper/Bubble/Spice/Cherry trees, Shrines to the Giants, Butler Roy, and roaming chickens/butterflies/piggies.

issues.detail: In `public/js/main.js`, `frame()` relies exclusively on `requestAnimationFrame(frame)` to run `stepSimulation(DT)`. In a multi-tab browser environment (such as 2-player rooms or when a player switches tabs), Chromium pauses `requestAnimationFrame` on background tabs, freezing that player's physics, inputs, and network sync until the tab is brought to the foreground. Add a fallback `setInterval` ticker when `document.hidden` or when `rAF` hasn't fired for >100ms so all connected players simulate continuously.
issues.evidence: Switching between Player 0 and Player 1 (`look(player: 1)` / `input(player: 1)`) caused held movement keys (`ArrowRight` / `ArrowLeft`) on the backgrounded player tab to register keydown and keyup before any simulation frame ticked, leaving `x: 680` unchanged.
issues.title: Simulation loop only runs in requestAnimationFrame, freezing backgrounded multiplayer tabs
People-here sidebar wipes innerHTML on every network state tick, swallowing clicks on players
issues.detail: In `public/js/main.js` (line 752), `onState() { updatePeopleList(); }` calls `updatePeopleList()` on every incoming network state tick (~10-20 times/sec), which executes `el.innerHTML = ""` and recreates all `.person-pill` DOM elements. If a network tick arrives between a player's `mousedown` and `mouseup` on a row in `#people-list`, the clicked DOM node is destroyed before `click` fires, swallowing the click. Only rebuild `#people-list` when the player list or a player's area/hiSign actually changes, or update existing rows in place.
issues.evidence: Clicking `Player2` in `#people-list` (`public/js/main.js:753, 825`) repeatedly failed or delayed opening the player verb popup because `onState` wiped `el.innerHTML = ""` every state broadcast.

issues.title: Player and NPC speech bubbles cap box width at 220-240px while drawing 350px+ text that overflows both sides
issues.evidence: On Beau's Home Street, squeezing the chicken displayed `ueezed the chicken! (+4 Mood, +1 Grai` overflowing out both sides of Player1's speech bubble; inspecting the Shovel displayed `Shovel: Ideal for excavating suspiciously neat Dirt Piles.` sticking 80px outside both edges of the bubble; Magic Rock's bubble truncated to `Want to know what I know? Ta` and Director Wigglesbottom's truncated to `Take a seat in the orange Waiting Area for 10 seconds be` while overflowing the box.
issues.detail: In `public/js/avatar.js` (line 442), player overhead speech bubbles cap `tw = Math.min(220, ...)` while drawing `String(p.speech).slice(0, 64)` (~350-400px wide) centered at `0` without wrapping or expanding the bubble width. Similarly, in `public/js/streets.js` (line 1009), NPC speech bubbles truncate mid-word at `.slice(0, 56)` and cap `tw = Math.min(240, ...)`, causing text to spill far outside both the left and right borders of the white speech bubble. Either size the rounded rectangle to `ctx.measureText(text).width + 24` or wrap long speech strings into 2 lines.

issues.title: Home Street left signpost fails boundary transition check (x: 430 vs < 300) and coasting to street edges doesn't trigger exit
issues.detail: In `public/js/main.js` (line 1187), walking to the left boundary checks `st.nodes.find(n => (n.type === "signpost" || n.type === "door") && n.x < 300 && n.verbs?.[0]?.target)`. However, on `home_street` (`public/js/streets.js:65`), `home_sign_left` is placed at `x: 430` (to the right of Beryl Rock at `x: 310`), so `n.x < 300` is false and walking to the left edge of Beau's Home Street (`x <= 42`) never transitions. Furthermore, boundary transitions require `moveInput !== 0` on the exact frame `p.x` crosses `st.width - 42`, so if a player releases the key slightly before the boundary and coasts to `st.width - 36`, they get stuck at the edge without transitioning.
issues.evidence: Walking left on `home_street` to `x = 36` did not transition because `home_sign_left.x` is `430` (`>= 300`). Walking right on `chego_chase` coasted to `x = 1864` (`st.width - 36`) without transitioning until `ArrowRight` was pressed again.

issues.detail: In Video B (04:35-05:25), the signature gag of the Andra Bureaucratic Hall is being told by Director Wigglesbottom to wait in the orange waiting area, where a 10-second "Please Wait" progress bar appears at top-right and scolds you ("You can't do anything while waiting. Just wait.") if you try to move, before Magister Piksnikson walks out and offers the "Card-Carrying Qualification (50c)" modal. In the rebuild, `q_bureaucrat` ("Proper Channels in Andra") completes the instant you teleport into `andra_hall` (`public/js/main.js:287`), and clicking the orange chair skips any 10-second wait timer and completes immediately.
issues.evidence: Teleporting to `andra_hall` immediately fired `quest_complete` for `q_bureaucrat` before interacting with any NPC or chair, and clicking the orange waiting chair instantly printed `You waited patiently in the orange chair!` with no timer UI. (Footage B 04:35-05:25).
issues.title: Andra Bureaucratic Hall quest auto-completes on entry and lacks the 10-second "Please Wait" timer gag from Footage B
Cauldron liquid in Goli Grabs floats detached above the pot rim and canvas hover labels overlap open verb popups
issues.evidence: In `Goli Grabs` (`x: 795, y: 490`), the orange oval above the cauldron floats detached in mid-air; clicking `Roy (Butler)` or `House of Whimsy` shows the canvas hover pill colliding with the top of the DOM popup.
issues.detail: In `public/js/streets.js`, the Simmering Cauldron in `goli_grabs` draws its bright orange soup ellipse floating in mid-air ~10px above the top rim of the black cauldron pot instead of resting inside the rim. Also, when a verb popup is open on a world node, the canvas hover label pill (`.hoveredObj`) renders at the same top position, poking out from behind the DOM verb menu.

Several UI elements use placeholder layouts or emojis instead of illustrated Glitch UI: (1) Clicking `Cultivate` / `Furniture Tab` replaces the bottom inventory bar with 4 plain solid-color circles (`35c`, `50c`, `80c`, `45c`) with no furniture icons or labels, and the toggle button still reads `🛋️ Furniture Tab`; (2) Top bar buttons and the welcome banner use system emojis (`🪨`, `📜`, `🎩`, `🌱`, `🗺️`, `🏠`, `✨`, `🛋️`); (3) The Street Spirit vendor modal (`B 05:50`) and World Map modal (`A 10:28`) are plain text lists rather than the horizontal icon shelf and illustrated map from the footage; (4) `Wardrobe` covers the center of the screen without a live avatar preview inside the modal; (5) `Quests` header says `"Favor with the 11 Giants of Ur"` but only lists 6 Giants.
issues.evidence: Observed across `Cultivate` bottom bar (`x: 785, y: 35`), `Street Spirit` browse modal, `World Map` modal, `Wardrobe` modal, and `Quests` modal. (Footage A 10:28, B 05:50).
issues.title: Furniture tab shows unlabeled colored circles, top bar uses emojis, and Vendor/Map/Wardrobe modals lack visual icons/previews

issues.detail: In `public/js/main.js`, `frame()` relies exclusively on `requestAnimationFrame(frame)` to run `stepSimulation(DT)`. In a multi-tab browser environment (such as 2-player rooms or when a player switches tabs), Chromium pauses `requestAnimationFrame` on background tabs, freezing that player's physics, inputs, and network sync until the tab is brought to the foreground. Add a fallback `setInterval` ticker when `document.hidden` or when `rAF` hasn't fired for >100ms so all connected players simulate continuously.
issues.evidence: Switching between Player 0 and Player 1 (`look(player: 1)` / `input(player: 1)`) caused held movement keys (`ArrowRight` / `ArrowLeft`) on the backgrounded player tab to register keydown and keyup before any simulation frame ticked, leaving `x: 680` unchanged.
issues.title: Simulation loop only runs in requestAnimationFrame, freezing backgrounded multiplayer tabs

issues.title: People-here sidebar wipes innerHTML on every network state tick, swallowing clicks on players
issues.detail: In `public/js/main.js` (line 752), `onState() { updatePeopleList(); }` calls `updatePeopleList()` on every incoming network state tick (~10-20 times/sec), which executes `el.innerHTML = ""` and recreates all `.person-pill` DOM elements. If a network tick arrives between a player's `mousedown` and `mouseup` on a row in `#people-list`, the clicked DOM node is destroyed before `click` fires, swallowing the click. Only rebuild `#people-list` when the player list or a player's area/hiSign actually changes, or update existing rows in place.
issues.evidence: Clicking `Player2` in `#people-list` (`public/js/main.js:753, 825`) repeatedly failed or delayed opening the player verb popup because `onState` wiped `el.innerHTML = ""` every state broadcast.

issues.title: Player and NPC speech bubbles cap box width at 220-240px while drawing 350px+ text that overflows both sides
issues.evidence: On Beau's Home Street, squeezing the chicken displayed `ueezed the chicken! (+4 Mood, +1 Grai` overflowing out both sides of Player1's speech bubble; inspecting the Shovel displayed `Shovel: Ideal for excavating suspiciously neat Dirt Piles.` sticking 80px outside both edges of the bubble; Magic Rock's bubble truncated to `Want to know what I know? Ta` and Director Wigglesbottom's truncated to `Take a seat in the orange Waiting Area for 10 seconds be` while overflowing the box.
issues.detail: In `public/js/avatar.js` (line 442), player overhead speech bubbles cap `tw = Math.min(220, ...)` while drawing `String(p.speech).slice(0, 64)` (~350-400px wide) centered at `0` without wrapping or expanding the bubble width. Similarly, in `public/js/streets.js` (line 1009), NPC speech bubbles truncate mid-word at `.slice(0, 56)` and cap `tw = Math.min(240, ...)`, causing text to spill far outside both the left and right borders of the white speech bubble. Either size the rounded rectangle to `ctx.measureText(text).width + 24` or wrap long speech strings into 2 lines.

issues.title: Home Street left signpost fails boundary transition check (x: 430 vs < 300) and coasting to street edges doesn't trigger exit
issues.detail: In `public/js/main.js` (line 1187), walking to the left boundary checks `st.nodes.find(n => (n.type === "signpost" || n.type === "door") && n.x < 300 && n.verbs?.[0]?.target)`. However, on `home_street` (`public/js/streets.js:65`), `home_sign_left` is placed at `x: 430` (to the right of Beryl Rock at `x: 310`), so `n.x < 300` is false and walking to the left edge of Beau's Home Street (`x <= 42`) never transitions. Furthermore, boundary transitions require `moveInput !== 0` on the exact frame `p.x` crosses `st.width - 42`, so if a player releases the key slightly before the boundary and coasts to `st.width - 36`, they get stuck at the edge without transitioning.
issues.evidence: Walking left on `home_street` to `x = 36` did not transition because `home_sign_left.x` is `430` (`>= 300`). Walking right on `chego_chase` coasted to `x = 1864` (`st.width - 36`) without transitioning until `ArrowRight` was pressed again.
